Cost modeling notes (high-level formula): monthly_unit_cost_per_1k_tokens = monthly_reserved_commit_cost / (estimated_monthly_tokens / 1000). Provided scenarios below.
Scenario assumptions used in workshop: target sustained traffic = 50 req/s; avg tokens/req = 60; seconds/month = 2,592,000 => baseline tokens/month = 50 * 60 * 2,592,000 = 7.776e9 tokens.
Commit pricing used (example): A100-80GB reservation = $20,000 / GPU / month (list example internal pricing), infra & support load = +15% -> effective per-GPU-month = $23,000.
Sample commit math (8x A100 example): monthly_commit_cost = 8 * $23,000 = $184,000. If QR achieves:
- 60% utilization scenario (effective tokens processed = 0.60 * baseline_tokens): tokens = 4.6656e9 -> cost_per_1k = $184,000 / 4,665,600 = $0.0394 per 1k tokens.
- 85% utilization scenario: tokens = 6.6096e9 -> cost_per_1k = $184,000 / 6,609,600 = $0.0278 per 1k tokens.
- 95% utilization (best case): tokens = 7.3872e9 -> cost_per_1k = $184,000 / 7,387,200 = $0.0249 per 1k tokens.

Notes on interpretation: these figures include reserved infra + support premium only; do NOT include per-request software licensing or data transfer adders. Hosted comparable per-1k numbers are lower for small volumes but increase at scale due to unit pricing differences.
